acceptance: Real CLI import preserves all three model occurrences and passes 30 independently specified assertions.

Unapplied source placement remains explicit; malformed vectors are retained with diagnostics without losing the component or pad.

verification.limitation: Timeout did not reproduce in the module rerun; root cause is not established. This is not a zero-failure full-suite claim or a physics/release qualification.

acceptance: Real CLI imports the digest-bound KiCad 10.0.6 native ODB geometry archive; all 14 independently specified assertions pass.
Native source/export gates recompute byte bindings, arc/pad/component geometry, cutout area/topology and net ownership; missing stackup/models and omitted generated font are explicit.
All 48 native pose and eight supported custom-pad/slot cases agree with current source import and geometry consumers; solver readiness stays false.

reported_failures: test_peec_volume_adapter.VolumeAdapterTests.test_optional_marble_ports_reflect_copper_connectivity: old isolation oracle contradicted native KiCad; subsequently corrected with native source-bound evidence and passing eight-test module.
test_python_debug.PythonDebugTest.test_parent_admits_design_bound_result: starting did not reach completed/failed within the 4-second deadline.
full_python_suite.followup: Native Gerber timeout reproduced unchanged earlier. Debug deadline failures remain unresolved. Marble oracle correction passed with no-zone separation controls. Full suite was not rerun after the test-only oracle correction; no zero-failure full-suite claim.

verification.limitation: Bounded import/source/display geometry acceptance only; no full-format, physical solver or release qualification.
